Name: WallPaper Recycler
Author: Mizzion
TagLine: A mod that allows players to reuse wallpaper and flooring.
Description:
This mod allows you to keep old wallpapers for your house. When you change wallpapers instead of losing the current one, this mod adds it to your inventory.

You can turn on or off the in game messages by editing the config.json file that is included in the zip file.

To Install, all you have to do is unzip the file and place the WallPaperRecycler folder inside of your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. It should work right after that.

**The first time you change your kitchen tiles, there's a bug that doesn't give the original back to you.**

It's basically the same thing as the old mod creaded by [iceburg](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1398716) . Mine is just updated to work with  SMAPI 2.4

Downloads.Description: Fixes the bug which always gave you the default wallpaper/floor
